_about: CLAUDE.md §5 steps 1 and 8. The device key is HMAC-SHA256(IP_SALT, IP | Riyadh date), an IPv6 address by its /64 prefix (reply 0033 §د); the IP itself is never stored. mosquesPerDay counts only lookups that reach Overpass (a cell already in that Cloudflare data centre's cache is free; the Cache API works on next's workers.dev, checked 13 Oct); pushSubscribesPerDay counts POST /api/push/subscribe.
_newAnswers: Reply 0037 §5. newAnswersPerDevice: new model calls a device may cause in a Riyadh day (/api/ask and /api/explain together; a cached answer, the FAQ, a referral or an apology is not one). burstPerMinute: the same calls in a minute, enforced by the Workers Rate Limiting binding BURST in env.next of worker/wrangler.jsonc (its simple.limit must equal this; worker/test/abuse-limits.test.ts checks).
_budget: Reply 0037 §5: the global monthly cap is a dollar budget, replacing the 30,000-call cap. Spent = usage_monthly.tokens_in × input + tokens_out × output, at the configured model's published price per million tokens (worker/src/config/llm.json "model"). Cached input ($0.014/M) is not told apart in the recorded usage, so every input token is priced at the full rate. Source: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/ (read 13 October 2026): @cf/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash-0731 «$0.440 per M input tokens», «$1.320 per M output tokens».
_recordings: Reply 0037 §5: a global monthly cap on /api/transcribe (Whisper large v3 turbo, $0.0005 per audio minute at the same source; 20,000 recordings of at most 30 s is at most $5), counted in usage_monthly.recordings (migration 0015).
